timecoded_text_to_speech.text: At Inventure, our mission is to create a global credit score for anyone with mobile phone.
The reason I started Inventure was really because I saw that there was a gap in the market.
I saw that these micro entrepreneurs that were working so hard to be able to grow their businesses
and help create jobs felt really stuck. They were getting access to these really informal micro loans
but beyond that point they couldn't get access to any kind of formal financial institution.
And when I went to the other side of the market and interviewed financial institutions
what I found was they felt that these micro entrepreneurs or individuals transacting in cash
were too risky. And so they didn't want to provide capital to them.
What I wanted to do was change that perception and to really be able to bring in real data
to be able to show that these individuals are not risky and that there is so much potential sitting there
that we really should break down that barrier.
We are currently running a business called Vanola Spice Food.
A running company called the Great Andres Catering Group.
My business is a splash cowash. I'm a protein internet cafe.
Insight works on any phone. An entrepreneur would use insight on a daily basis.
They would text in their daily income, their daily expenses.
And then what we send them back is basically a really simplified income statement.
So it actually shows them how much money they made today, how much they spent today
and what their daily profit is. And so in that sense they get this kind of summary or awareness saying,
okay today was a good day, today was a bad day, but they know what they're now working towards.
It actually makes you aware of the time of how things are going in your business in terms of revenue, expenses and profit.
I can see where I spend the most.
Now I can see okay I don't need to spend this much on this. I don't need to spend this much on that.
I saved a lot of time just by sending an SMS.
But in addition to that, what insight provides to them is that formal proof and that formal identity
that they can then take to a financial institution to ask for that growth capital to grow their business.
If I grow, insight will be able to show these people that I'm growing.
I was fortunate to find this system at the beginning, you know,
because all my transactions have been recorded and now I can tell a story about the performance of my business.
Just getting to now see people using insight has been just remarkable.
You know it's something that I designed when I was working full time, kind of in my little office,
thinking of myself as kind of a mad scientist, trying to bring this data out into the world,
but to actually see the fact that it's changing people's lives.
We have a lot of opportunities here. Once it's formalized, then I can go to big companies.
We like to expand in such a way that we have more branches.
So in the near future, my plan is to catering as well.
The plan of extending the place is to make it bigger, put more, more, more expectations.
You know I know it's going to take time, but it's all about having patience, you know.
They're actually getting small business loans to grow their businesses and employ people.
We've seen that people are now doubling their savings.
We've seen that, you know, we see entrepreneurs that have had buckets of receipts,
you know, before using something like this.
And now they have a simple income statement on their mobile phone.
But I think the really simple stories that we've seen are just people telling us that, you know,
now as a result of using insight, they actually know how much money they have.
You know, how much money they make on a daily basis.
And that kind of awareness to me is just the biggest thing that we could have done.
Now that they have that awareness, they have the abilities to really grow their businesses themselves.

youtube_description:
Around the world, 4.5 billion individuals lack a formal financial identity. This translates into hundreds of thousands of businesses struggling to grow, forcing many entrepreneurs to take informal micro-loans that do little to help them establish a credit score. Through InSight - an SMS accounting tool - TED Fellow Shivani Siroya has spent the last several years developing a financial model that successfully measures profitability, thus establishing a true evaluation of an entrepreneur's long term viability. Today, InSight is the daily go-to accounting and financial service for tens of thousands of businesses, giving them a better understanding of their profits, inventory, and financial health. 

Learn more about InSight at: http://inventure.org/using/learn-about-insight
Learn more about the TED Fellow Program at: www.ted.com/fellows
